title: About Kopano
text: Kopano Microfinance is a licensed micro lender regulated by the Non-Bank Financial Institutions Regulatory Authority (NBFIRA). We have provided loans to salaried workers, small business owners and families in Botswana since 2014.

title: Complaints Procedure
text: We take complaints seriously and aim to resolve them quickly and fairly.

title: Complaints Procedure
text:
• Through the website chat — ask to speak to an agent
• By phone on +267 395 0100
• By email to help@kopano.example
• In person at any branch
What happens next
1. A customer service agent acknowledges your complaint within 1 business day
2. We investigate and aim to resolve it within 10 business days
3. If you are not satisfied, your complaint is escalated to the Head of Customer Operations
4. If you are still not satisfied after our final response, you may refer your complaint to the Non-Bank Financial
Institutions Regulatory Authority (NBFIRA)
Collections contact about any amount under dispute is paused while we investigate.

title: Customer Service Standards
text: These standards apply to everyone who serves Kopano customers, including the website chat assistant.

title: Customer Service Standards
section: Transfer to a customer service agent
text:
Transfer the conversation to a human agent when:
• The customer asks to speak to a person, a manager or an agent
• The customer is upset, frustrated or making a complaint
• The customer disputes a payment, balance, penalty or charge
• The customer says they are in financial hardship or cannot pay
• The customer asks for a payment holiday, restructuring or top-up
• Identity verification fails three times
• The question cannot be answered accurately from our policies or the customer's account records
• There is any suggestion of fraud
When transferring, pass on the full conversation and the customer's account details so the customer does not need to repeat themselves. Tell the customer they are being transferred and when to expect a response. Outside agent hours, tell the customer when an agent will be available.

title: Customer Service Standards
text:
• Give accurate information only. Never guess amounts, dates or policy.
• Account figures must come from the customer's records.
• Do not promise outcomes that require approval, such as waiving a penalty or approving a payment holiday.
• Be polite, clear and brief.

title: Early Settlement
text: You may settle your loan in full at any time.

title: Early Settlement
text:
Your settlement amount is your outstanding balance less a 5% early settlement discount. There is no early settlement fee.
Example: if your outstanding balance is P10,000, your settlement amount is P9,500.
A settlement quote is valid only on the day it is given. If you have overdue instalments or penalties, they are included in the outstanding balance.

title: Early Settlement
text:
• Get your settlement amount from the chat assistant, a customer service agent or your branch
• Pay the full amount using any method in How to Pay Your Loan
• Use the reference SETTLE- followed by your loan ID, for example SETTLE-KM-L-0123
Your loan is closed within 2 business days of the payment reflecting, and a paid-up letter is sent to you by SMS or email.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: Where do I find my loan ID?
text: On your loan agreement and on every SMS we send you. It looks like KM-L-0123.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: I paid but my balance hasn't changed. Why?
text: Payments take time to reflect: up to 1 business day for mobile money and 2 business days for bank transfers, or up to 5 business days if the reference was missing or wrong. If it has been longer, speak to an agent and have your transaction reference ready.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: Can I pay more than my instalment?
text: Yes. Extra payments reduce your outstanding balance. They do not change your future instalment amount.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: How do I get a statement?
text: Ask a customer service agent. Statements are sent by email or SMS within 2 business days.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: How do I change my registered phone number?
text: Visit any branch with your Omang or passport. For your security, this cannot be done by phone or chat.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: Can I get a new loan while I still have one?
text: You may hold more than one loan if you qualify. You may also apply for a top-up once half of your current loan is repaid.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
section: Do you offer loans to people who are self-employed?
text: Yes, through the Small Business Loan, if the business has traded for at least 12 months.

title: How to Pay Your Loan
section: How long payments take to reflect
text:
Orange Money, MyZaka, Smega: Within 1 business day
Bank transfer: Within 2 business days
Any payment with a missing or incorrect reference: Up to 5 business days
The date we use to decide whether you paid on time is the date the payment was received, not the date it reflected on your loan.
Kopano staff will never ask for your mobile money PIN or banking password.

title: Late Payment Policy
text:
Version 3.0 · Effective 1 March 2025 · This policy supersedes all previous versions of the late payment
and penalty policy.

title: Late Payment Policy
text:
You have a grace period of 5 calendar days after your due date. There is no penalty if your instalment is received
within the grace period.

title: Late Payment Policy
text:
If an instalment is still unpaid at the end of the 5-day grace period, a one-off penalty of 5% of the overdue
instalment is charged, up to a maximum of P250 per instalment.
• The penalty is charged once per missed instalment. It does not increase daily or weekly.
• No additional interest is charged on arrears.
Example: your instalment is P1,000, due on the 10th. If you pay on the 14th, there is no penalty. If you pay on the
17th, a penalty of P50 is added.
How we contact you about late payments
• We send an SMS reminder 3 days before your due date
• If your instalment is unpaid after the grace period, your loan officer will contact you by phone, WhatsApp or
SMS
• We contact customers only between 08:00 and 18:00, Monday to Saturday, and never on Sundays or public
holidays
• We contact you no more than once per day about the same instalment
• If you tell us you have already paid, we pause collections contact for up to 2 business days while we confirm
the payment
Credit bureau reporting
Loans more than 60 days in arrears are reported to the credit bureau.

title: Loan Products
text: All interest is charged at a flat monthly rate on the original loan amount. Your monthly instalment stays the same for the life of the loan.

title: Loan Products
text:
For formally employed people with a payslip.
• Loan amount: P1,000 to P20,000
• Term: 3 to 12 months
• Interest: 2.5% per month, flat
• Instalments due: the 25th of each month
• Requirements: Omang, three latest payslips, three months' bank statements

title: Loan Products
text:
For registered or informal businesses that have traded for at least 12 months.
• Loan amount: P5,000 to P100,000
• Term: 6 to 36 months
• Interest: 2.0% per month, flat
• Instalments due: the 10th of each month
• Requirements: Omang, six months' business bank or mobile money statements, proof of business address

title: Loan Products
text:
For school, college and university fees, paid directly to the institution.
• Loan amount: P2,000 to P30,000
• Term: 3 to 12 months
• Interest: 1.75% per month, flat
• Instalments due: the 15th of each month
• Requirements: Omang, fees invoice from the institution, proof of income

title: Loan Products
section: Due dates on weekends and public holidays
text: If your due date falls on a weekend or public holiday, a payment received by the end of the next business day is treated as on time.

title: Loan Products
text: Once you have repaid at least half of your loan, you may apply for a top-up. Speak to your loan officer or a customer service agent.

title: Payment Holidays and Restructuring
text:
A payment holiday lets you skip one monthly instalment. The skipped instalment is added to the end of your loan,
which extends your term by one month.
You may be eligible if all of the following apply:
• Your loan has been active for at least 6 months
• You have missed no more than one instalment in the last 6 months
• You have not previously taken a payment holiday on this loan
• Your loan is not currently more than 30 days in arrears
An administration fee of P150 applies. Only one payment holiday is allowed per loan.
How to apply: payment holidays must be approved by a customer service agent or your loan officer. Apply before
your due date. The chat assistant cannot approve a payment holiday.

title: Payment Holidays and Restructuring
text:
If you are struggling to pay because of job loss, illness, a death in the family or a fall in business income, please
tell us as early as possible. We may be able to restructure your loan by extending the term or reducing your
instalments.
Restructuring requires an assessment by a customer service agent, who will ask about your circumstances and
may request supporting documents. Restructuring may affect your credit record.

title: Penalties and Charges
text: Version 2.1 · Effective 1 January 2023

title: Penalties and Charges
text:
Instalments must be received on or before the due date. There is no grace period.
If an instalment is received after the due date, a penalty of 10% of the instalment is charged immediately. A further 1% of the instalment is charged for each additional week the instalment remains unpaid.

title: Penalties and Charges
text: A fee of P75 is charged for any debit order or payment that is reversed or returned.

title: Penalties and Charges
text: Loans more than 30 days in arrears are reported to the credit bureau.

title: Privacy and Account Verification
text:
Before we share any information about your loan, we must confirm who you are. You will be asked for:
1. The mobile number registered on your loan, and
2. The last four digits of your Omang or passport number
We will not share any account information until both match our records. After three failed attempts, the
conversation is transferred to a customer service agent.

title: Privacy and Account Verification
section: Who we share your information with
text:
We only discuss your loan with you. We do not share your loan information with anyone else — including your
spouse, relatives, friends or employer — even if they say they have your permission. Anyone who wishes to act
on your behalf must visit a branch with you and complete a signed authority form.

title: Privacy and Account Verification
text:
Information about our products, policies, branches and how to pay is not personal and can be shared with
anyone.

title: Privacy and Account Verification
text:
Kopano will never ask for your PIN, password or one-time code. If anyone asks for these claiming to be from
Kopano, do not share them and report it to us.
